chapters.title: Rama's Teachings to Lakshmana on Knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
अहमात्मा सदा शुद्धः सर्वभूतगुहाशयः ।
सर्वव्यापी च सर्वज्ञः सर्वभूतेषु संस्थितः ॥
verses.translation: I am the Self, ever pure, dwelling in the cave of the hearts of all beings — all-pervading, all-knowing, established in all creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः ।
तेषामादित्यवज् ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ॥
verses.translation: But for those whose ignorance is destroyed by the knowledge of the Self, their knowledge, like the sun, illuminates that Supreme Truth.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मं चरत मा पापं सत्यं वद प्रियं वद ।
दैवं चिन्तय नित्यं त्वं मा अधर्मं समाचर ॥
verses.translation: Practice dharma, do not commit sin. Speak truth, speak what is pleasant. Always contemplate the divine. Never practice unrighteousness.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
verses.translation: One whose self is established in yoga sees the Self in all beings and all beings in the Self, seeing equally everywhere.

verses.sanskrit:
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ।
धर्मात्मा सततं शुद्धः मोक्षमाप्नोति शाश्वतम् ॥
verses.translation: Never does one who does good, O son, come to grief. The righteous soul, ever pure, attains eternal liberation.
